dataset: CUAD v1; source-span field task, not official QA scoring
development: 20 official-train contracts; one frozen prompt design, no test tuning. Record parsing and viability decision before test collection.
test: Up to 60 official-test contracts; all five fields at most one distinct whitespace-normalized answer, full source <=40000 characters, exact answer offsets verified; use actual eligible count without relaxing filters.
primary: Mean document F1(repair_index) minus mean document F1(extract_index), whitespace-normalized exact relation/value matching, document IDs assigned by code in all arms. No reference-dependent filtering and no source gate in the primary output.
statistics: 10000 paired document bootstrap resamples, seed 20260929, percentile 95% interval; two-sided paired sign-flip Monte Carlo p with 100000 draws and plus-one correction. One primary test. All other contrasts descriptive; report denominators, not pooled fields as independent replicates.
failures: Failed output is empty graph in primary scoring; do not delete failed cases. Preserve requests, raw responses, attempts and finish reason. Missing usage remains null. At most four transport attempts; completed failures not rerun. Stop collection when both requests in a wave fail transport.
parsing: One outer JSON Markdown fence accepted; otherwise strict JSON object with triples list and string head/relation/tail. Assign public document ID uniformly; retain unsupported relations/multiple values for scoring, no favorable candidate selection.
additional_metrics: field exact accuracy including correctly absent fields
semantic_scope: Exact source-span reference agreement is not independent human semantic correctness. CUAD values can be legal clauses, not canonical dates. Pretrained-model dataset contamination cannot be ruled out.
human_status: Deferred by user on 2026-09-29. Preserve original annotation deliveries; no model-filled judgments.
